currentParagraphText: “Seeing as I did not notice who teleported you in here, I assume it was the Malefic One?” the vampire asked him.

finalResult.previousParagraphText: Back in the Treasure Hunt, he’d swiped a few paintings of a more... risque nature. He recognized her from some of those paintings, which also made him realize she had to be a really old vampire god. Not that she looked old, at least not compared to the Sword Saint. She didn’t have that old-person vibe at all.
